statement_audit.local_binders: B and C are deterministic local carrier definitions, and blocks is a deterministic map. The (i,p) bounds live within B; b, c and the flat coefficient input are bound inside the map, not theorem inputs. The finite-dimensional Euclidean, Fintype, Borel and product-measurable instances are canonical infrastructure; no project-owned proposition or typeclass adds conditions.
statement_audit.generalization: The paper opens Section 4.1.1 with sufficiently large integer n and h=floor((log n)^(1/3)/32). The isolated finite law permits arbitrary positive n and natural h because all carrier and law formulas remain well-defined there. This does not generalize the hard-family admissibility, parameter bounds or oracle results. d_n=(h+1)n is the spatial dimension, not the coefficient dimension.
statement_audit.conclusion: HasLaw requires AE measurability and equality of the pushforward of the flat standard Gaussian to Measure.pi of the block standard Gaussians. Both are conclusions, not hypotheses. Evaluation gives the standard Gaussian marginals, and the product of those marginals gives mutual (not merely pairwise) independence of the block projections. Such downstream named Lean lemmas are not asserted or certified by this review.
statement_audit.scope: Exact identity-covariance, centered coefficient law before conditioning. Not the variance-2/3 spatial Gaussian, the scaled angular scalar law, a law conditioned on admissibility, or independence of arbitrary/adaptively chosen field values.

definition_audit.parameters_and_endpoints: K=2^(74*(h+1)) and P=2^(64*(h+1)), with no swapped constants. Fin(h+1) gives i=0,...,h. Fin(P+1) and the Even / 4<=p filter give exactly p=4,6,...,P; P is always even and at least 4. For relative j=0,...,h-i, Fin(K^j) labels the repetitions of u_(i+j), so there is one at j=0 and the last has K^(h-i) repetitions. Since i<=h, natural subtraction is exact; at i=h the sum S_i is 1.
definition_audit.coordinates: Each slot is one of p copies of the whole trailing tensor and one of the S_i=sum_(j=0)^(h-i) K^j trailing slots. Thus the ordered slot set has cardinality p*S_i and the function type from it to Fin(n) indexes n^(p*S_i) tensor entries. There is neither a symmetric-power quotient nor a replacement of p*S_i with a degree-only coordinate space. For each b the degree value and the carrier coincide with the individual AngularDegree component's coefficient carrier after unpacking the bounded degree subtype.
definition_audit.direction: The source starts with independent standard blocks and collects them, hence flatten_*(product_b stdGaussian_b)=stdGaussian_flat in the coordinate realization. The signature is the inverse statement: group_*(stdGaussian_flat)=product_b stdGaussian_b. The inverse is explicit: group(ξ)(b)(c)=ξ(b,c) and flatten(x)(b,c)=x(b)(c). Both are measurable coordinate rearrangements on the finite carriers; no arbitrary coupling or representative choice is involved.
definition_audit.euclidean_geometry: The entrywise coordinate bijection identifies the flat squared norm sum_(b,c)|ξ(b,c)|² with sum_b||group(ξ)(b)||². The geometric target is the l² orthogonal direct sum; the signature's bare dependent Pi carries the product measurable structure, not the direct-sum norm. Do not claim an isometry into a sup norm or a norm theorem as part of HasLaw. There is no rotation, change of variances, tensor symmetrization or rescaling.
